ety: ร่วมเชื้อสายกับอีสาน ติด, ลาว ຕິດ (ติด), คำเมือง ᨲᩥ᩠ᨯ (ติด), เขิน ᨲᩥ᩠ᨯ (ติด), ไทลื้อ ᦎᦲᧆ (ตีด), ไทใหญ่ တိတ်း (ติ๊ต), อาหม 𑜄𑜢𑜄𑜫 (ติต์)
rule: ติด has eighteen senses and almost all of them are one idea — caught and not coming loose — so the filing works by asking WHAT does the catching. Physical adhesion, one surface pressed to another, files at 3. Fire catching files at 8. Contiguity, and so continuity, files at 9. Staying put, or being made to stay, files at 11. A habit one cannot do without files at 5. Affixing a thing onto something else files at 2. Sense 1 is the residue and the largest group: a person or thing simply CAUGHT — snagged, obstructed, tied up, trapped — with no surface, no fire and no habit named.

notes.h2: 2026-09-21 — รม, ติด, เก็บ (30 filed, 21 tagged false-split) · a head that was almost all wreckage
notes.text:
**Rule.** ติด has eighteen senses and nearly all are one idea — caught and not
coming loose — so the filing asks WHAT does the catching. A surface pressed to a
surface files at 3 (ติดเก้ง, ติดเป้ง). Fire catching files at 8 (ติดเครื่อง —
starting an engine is lighting it). Contiguity, and so continuity, files at 9
(ติดต่อ, ติดพัน). Staying put or being made to stay files at 11 (ติดตัว,
ติดตลาด, ติดอันดับ). A habit one cannot do without files at 5 (ติดสำนวน).
Affixing one thing onto another files at 2 (ติดสินบน, money pinned on a person,
the ติดกัณฑ์เทศน์ gesture). Sense 1 is the residue and the largest group: a person
or thing simply CAUGHT, with no surface, no fire and no habit named — ติดอ่าง the
snagging voice, ติดงาน tied up, ติดขัด (whose gloss ขัดข้อง is sense 1's own
wording back at it), ติดดอย stuck holding a stock bought high, ติดสัด.

notes.h2: 2026-09-21 — รม, ติด, เก็บ (30 filed, 21 tagged false-split) · a head that was almost all wreckage
notes.text:
**Two I am unsure of.** ติดสัด at 1 could be 5 — estrus as a craving rather than a
condition one is seized by; I took "seized by" because the RID glosses it as an
อาการ of the season, not of the animal's wanting. ติดอันดับ at 11 is the ติด of
สอบติด and ติดโผ, landing a place and holding it, and the RID has no sense for
"to be selected" — 11 is the nearest, not a fit.
